answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 14543 Country: India Title: as salaam maulana last week there was robbery in our house thief has robbed my father mobile and money so please give dua or zikhar so that robbed things must get back and soon thief must get chaught? Question: as salaam maulana last week there was robbery in our house thief has robbed my father mobile and money so please give dua or zikhar so that robbed things must get back and soon thief must get chaught? Answer ID: 14543 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1148/1148=M/1430) You should keep patience and turn to Allah. If you suspect someone of theft for valid reasons, you can enquire according to Shariah, but you should not suspect someone unnecessarily. Pray to Allah after salah and recite Ya Mu?eez ( یا معیذ ), if Allah wills, you will get it back. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
